Title: Buffalo Wings with Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Buffalo Wings | 1000 g | chicken wing |  | 000048
- Buffalo Wings | 100 g | Cornstarch |  | 000649
- Buffalo Wings | 5 g | table salt |  | 000292
- Buffalo Wings | 1 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 100 g | butter |  | 000384
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 3 tsp | Cayenne Pepper |  | 000652
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 1 tsp | Chili Powder |  | 000653
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 1 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 1 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 60 ml | White Vinegar |  | 000637
- Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | 1 tsp | table salt |  | 000292

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Buffalo Wings | Prep |  | Pat the chicken wings completely dry with paper towels; safety: ensure raw poultry is handled carefully and surfaces are sanitized afterward.
2. Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | Prep |  | Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until completely liquid.
3. Buffalo Wings | Prep |  | In a large bowl, whisk together the cornstarch, salt, and ground black pepper.
4. Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | Cook |  | Whisk in the cayenne pepper, chili powder, garlic powder, and ground onion, stirring for 1 minute to toast the spices.
5. Buffalo Wings | Prep |  | Toss the dried wings in the cornstarch mixture until they are thinly and evenly coated, shaking off any excess powder.
6. Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | Cook |  | Pour in the white vinegar and add a teaspoon of salt, whisking vigorously to emulsify the fat and liquid.
7. Buffalo Wings | Cook |  | Heat deep-frying oil in a heavy pot or deep fryer to 190°C.
8. Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | Cook |  | Simmer the sauce gently on low heat for 5 minutes until it thickens slightly and develops a glossy sheen.
9. Buffalo Wings | Cook |  | Fry the wings in small batches for 10-12 minutes until the skin is golden brown and very crispy.
10. Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | Serve |  | Place the hot fried wings in a large stainless steel bowl and pour the warm sauce over them.
11. Buffalo Wings | Cook |  | Ensure the internal temperature of the wings reaches 74°C for safety.
12. Spicy Cayenne Hot Sauce | Serve |  | Toss the wings until every piece is thoroughly glazed and serve immediately.
13. Buffalo Wings | Serve |  | Remove wings from the oil and drain on a wire rack for 2 minutes to maintain crispiness.
